Amp Room is a proper space — a live room stacked with amps for playing loud, and a full production suite with a mixing desk, studio monitors and a vocal booth for making records.
It means your production lesson happens on the same gear the pros use, and your first take can end up being a real recording. You’re making music here, not just taking a class.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Amp Room is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A live room with amps, a drum kit and warm stage lighting

children: We started Amp Room because the way most people are taught music is backwards — years of scales before you’re allowed to play anything you like. So we flipped it: you play real songs from lesson one, and the technique comes with them.

It’s a contemporary studio for guitar, vocals, bass, production and songwriting — teens and adults, total beginners and returning players. Real gear, working-musician teachers, and a room that makes you want to keep showing up.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Bring what you love and we build the skills around it. You’ll be playing real music long before it stops feeling like work.
Book the same teacher each week. They learn how you learn, track your progress, and plan every lesson around where you’re headed.
Recitals, open mics and studio recordings. We give you reasons to play in front of people, because that’s where it gets real.
